     "Contract (link; required; links to Contracts)",
     "Due (date)",
     "New value a year (money)",
     "Decision (choice; choices: Renew, End)",
     "Notes (long_text)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Contacts",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Contract (link; required; links to Contracts)",
     "Name (text; required)",
     "Role (text)",
     "Email (email)",
     "Phone (phone)"
    ]
   }
  ],
  "roles": [
   "Contract managers: every row",
   "Contract owners: their own rows"
  ],
  "rules": [
   "90 days before a contract’s notice date, move it to Renewal due and remind its owner.",
   "30 days before the notice date, if it is still in Renewal due, tell Wade and the owner.",
   "When a signed PDF is added, an AI step reads it and fills the row for the owner to confirm; then it moves to Signed.",
   "When a contract enters Legal review, Lena approves or declines it; the contract waits on her."
  ]
 }
